```{r}
#| label: fig-emp-lost-demand-proxy-inventory-value
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 6
#| out.height: "75%"
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| fig-cap: "Empirical inventory trade-off between lost-demand rate and total proxy opening inventory value across replenishment policies."

frontier_lost_demand_value <- plot_df_emp_inv |>
  group_by(policy) |>
  mutate(
    frontier = !purrr::map_lgl(
      seq_len(n()),
      ~ any(
        total_proxy_inventory_value <= total_proxy_inventory_value[.x] &
          lost_demand_rate <= lost_demand_rate[.x] &
          (
            total_proxy_inventory_value < total_proxy_inventory_value[.x] |
              lost_demand_rate < lost_demand_rate[.x]
          ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

frontier_lost_demand_value_path <- frontier_lost_demand_value |>
  filter(frontier) |>
  arrange(policy, total_proxy_inventory_value, lost_demand_rate)

ggplot(frontier_lost_demand_value, aes(x = total_proxy_inventory_value, y = lost_demand_rate)) +
  geom_path(
    data = frontier_lost_demand_value_path,
    aes(group = policy),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = model, shape = model), size = 3, stroke=1, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colour_values) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = model_shape_values) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  labels = scales::label_number(
    scale = 1e-6,
    suffix = "M",
    prefix = "$",
    accuracy = 0.01)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~policy, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Total proxy opening inventory value",
    y = "Lost-demand rate",
    colour = "Method",
    shape = "Method"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
